{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Count total rows and rows with sentinel value
total_rows = len(df)
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Filter out sentinel values
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]
valid_rows = len(df_filtered)

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = df_filtered['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"total_rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"sentinel_count: {sentinel_count}")
print(f"valid_rows: {valid_rows}")
print(f"mean_baseline: {mean_baseline}")"}
